in_hebrew.name: Lira
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Lira הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin word 'lira', meaning lyre or harp. This name symbolizes the divine connection between music, creativity, and the cycles of nature, particularly the harvest moon.

in_greek.name: Lira
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Harvest Moon
in_greek.long_meaning: Lira είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Latin word 'lira', meaning lyre or harp. This name symbolizes the divine connection between music, creativity, and the cycles of nature, particularly the harvest moon.

in_latin.name: Lira
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Harvest Moon
